subject: general
question: What is the theme of the Grameen Bharat Mahotsav 2025?

options.text: Building a Resilient Rural India for a Viksit Bharat 2047

solution:
The correct answer is __**Building a Resilient Rural India for a Viksit Bharat 2047.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Grameen Bharat Mahotsav 2025 on January 4th, 2025, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme of the Mahotsav is "Building a Resilient Rural India for a Viksit Bharat 2047".**
 
• **It celebrates rural India's entrepreneurial spirit and cultural heritage.**
 
• **Focus areas include empowering rural women, enhancing infrastructure, fostering innovation, and promoting financial security.**
 
• **The motto of the event is “गांव बढ़े, तो देश बढ़े”.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Grameen Bharat Mahotsav 2025__

 __
 
• Aims to enhance rural livelihoods through technology and innovation.
 
• Features workshops, discussions, and masterclasses to foster self-reliant economies.
 
• Special focus on empowering rural women and supporting sustainable agricultural practices.
 
 
 
• Significance__
 
 
• Encourages collaboration between government officials, rural entrepreneurs, artisans, and stakeholders.
 
• Showcases India's rich cultural heritage through vibrant performances and exhibitions.
